name: Bounty: Bandit Boss
canDoWhy: A repeatable bounty the game hands out on its own as you travel into a hold; the target and hold are picked at random.

starts.how: Starts by itself when you arrive somewhere in a hold. The quest's cast includes an innkeeper and a bounty letter, so the bounty most likely reaches you as a letter from an innkeeper.

firstStep: Kill the bandit leader at the place named in the bounty

takesYou.place: the place named in the bounty (shown on your map)
takesYou.why: kill the bandit leader at the place named in the bounty

takesYou.place: the jarl's hall of that hold
takesYou.why: collect the bounty from the steward or the jarl

objectives: Kill the bandit leader located at <the place> in <the hold>
Collect the bounty from the steward (or the jarl)

rewards.what: A random item from the bounty reward list

people.name: The hold's jarl
people.role: pays the bounty if there is no steward to see

unsure.why: The records show the start comes from arriving in a hold, and that an innkeeper and a letter are part of the quest, but not the line or event that hands the letter over.
Favor Quests Separated adds its own hold-by-hold copies of this bounty. These files don't show whether this original version still fires alongside them or is shut off.
The place, the hold and who pays are picked when the quest starts; the records don't fix them.
What is on the bounty reward list isn't in these files.
